showcases.title_zh: Findphone：Claude 协助制作的蓝牙寻机工具
showcases.summary_en: The creator describes asking Claude for a way to find an MDM-disabled phone, then using the generated macOS Bluetooth RSSI meter to walk toward the stronger signal and recover it.
showcases.summary_zh: 作者讲述在手机受 MDM 限制、无法使用 Find My 时向 Claude 求助，再用生成的 macOS 蓝牙 RSSI 仪表沿着增强的信号找回手机。

showcases.title_zh: OpenQuadruped 开源四足机器人展示
showcases.summary_en: Shows a 3D-printed 12-DOF robot dog and its CAD, PCB, ROS, gait, inverse-kinematics, and simulation material; reinforcement learning remains a planned item.
showcases.summary_zh: 展示 3D 打印 12 自由度机器狗及其 CAD、PCB、ROS、步态、逆运动学和仿真资料；强化学习仍属于计划项。

showcases.title_zh: 周末搭建 Gemini Robotics 实验室
showcases.summary_en: Demonstrates Gemini Robotics ER 2 controlling a MuJoCo arm in Docker before deployment to Azure; no implementation repository is linked.
showcases.summary_zh: 演示 Gemini Robotics ER 2 在 Docker 中控制 MuJoCo 机械臂并部署到 Azure；帖子未提供实现仓库。

showcases.title_zh: Gemma 智能眼镜上下文演示
showcases.summary_en: Shows a hackathon prototype capturing ambient input through smart glasses and processing it with a custom context engine and Gemma inference; no source code is linked.
showcases.summary_zh: 展示黑客马拉松原型通过智能眼镜捕获环境输入，再由自定义上下文引擎和 Gemma 推理处理；帖子没有源码链接。

showcases.title_zh: 10 美元开发板运行 PicoLM
showcases.summary_en: Explains PicoLM's memory footprint, board-level token speeds, architecture optimizations, prompt-cache behavior, and use as PicoClaw's fully offline local brain.
showcases.summary_zh: 介绍 PicoLM 的内存占用、不同开发板速度、架构优化、提示词缓存，以及作为 PicoClaw 完全离线本地大脑的用法。

showcases.title_zh: Buddie 全栈语音硬件伴侣
showcases.summary_en: Walks through the appeal of a DIY voice companion and highlights Buddie's schematics, PCB, BOM, embedded firmware, and Flutter application.
showcases.summary_zh: 从自制语音伴侣的动机出发，展示 Buddie 的电路原理图、PCB、BOM、嵌入式固件和 Flutter 应用。

showcases.title_en: Codex status on a smart lamp
showcases.title_zh: 用智能台灯显示 Codex 状态
showcases.summary_en: The creator describes the overnight idea and debugging process, then demonstrates orange approval, breathing work, and cool completion states on a Mi Home lamp.
showcases.summary_zh: 作者讲述从前一晚偶然想到、由 Codex 协助调试，到米家台灯呈现橙色待批准、呼吸执行和冷色完成状态的全过程。

showcases.title_zh: Omi 可穿戴第二大脑
showcases.summary_en: Frames Omi as an always-available assistant that observes screen and audio context, then proactively provides guidance while keeping its stack open for inspection.
showcases.summary_zh: 把 Omi 作为持续获取屏幕与音频上下文、主动提供下一步建议，并允许用户审查完整技术栈的随身助手来介绍。

showcases.title_zh: SABR 自平衡机器人构建过程
showcases.summary_en: Compresses the creator's CAD, 3D printing, PCB, embedded code, Kalman filtering, PID tuning, and balancing result into a one-minute build video.
showcases.summary_zh: 用一分钟视频浓缩作者从 CAD、3D 打印、PCB、嵌入式代码、卡尔曼滤波和 PID 调参到真实平衡的完整过程。

showcases.title_zh: ESP32-S3 端侧语言模型
showcases.summary_en: Explains and demonstrates a 28.9-million-parameter language model running fully offline on an ESP32-S3, including its flash paging architecture and measured speed.
showcases.summary_zh: 讲解并演示 2890 万参数语言模型在 ESP32-S3 上完全离线运行，包括 Flash 分页架构和实测生成速度。

showcases.title_zh: Home Generative Agent 自动化演示
showcases.summary_en: Demonstrates a plain-English request becoming a real Home Assistant automation, including generated YAML, local execution, and a phone notification action.
showcases.summary_zh: 演示如何把自然语言需求直接变成真实 Home Assistant 自动化，包括生成 YAML、本地执行和手机通知动作。

showcases.title_zh: KittenTTS 轻量边缘语音模型
showcases.summary_en: Highlights a 25–80 MB CPU-only text-to-speech family for edge deployment; the repository provides a model library but no concrete hardware integration build.
showcases.summary_zh: 介绍面向边缘部署的 25–80 MB 纯 CPU 文本转语音模型；仓库提供模型库，但尚未给出具体硬件集成构建。

showcases.title_zh: DroneBridge 低成本 ESP32 遥测链路
showcases.summary_en: Introduces an inexpensive low-latency ESP32 telemetry bridge for drones and robots with ESP-NOW, Wi-Fi, MAVLink, and related protocols; the implementation contains no AI component.
showcases.summary_zh: 介绍面向无人机和机器人的低成本低延迟 ESP32 遥测桥，支持 ESP-NOW、Wi-Fi、MAVLink 等协议；实现本身不含 AI 组件。

showcases.title_zh: LightMem-Ego 可穿戴记忆系统
showcases.summary_en: Explains how Rokid AI glasses stream first-person camera and audio context into current, short-term, and long-term memory layers for evidence-backed recall.
showcases.summary_zh: 讲解 Rokid AI 眼镜如何把第一视角摄像头与音频上下文流入当前、短期和长期记忆层，并提供带证据的回忆结果。

showcases.title_zh: RoboParty Party OS 人形机器人全栈
showcases.summary_en: Maps the humanoid workflow from motion retargeting and imitation learning to unsupervised reinforcement learning and real-robot deployment across the Party OS subprojects.
showcases.summary_zh: 梳理 Party OS 各子项目如何覆盖动作重定向、模仿学习、无监督强化学习和真机部署的人形机器人完整流程。

showcases.title_zh: ROBOTIS AI Worker 混合控制
showcases.summary_en: An official engineer demonstrates combining Behavior Trees with a VLA framework so a ROBOTIS AI Worker can complete complex long-horizon tasks.
showcases.summary_zh: 官方工程师演示把 Behavior Tree 与 VLA 框架结合，使 ROBOTIS AI Worker 完成复杂长时程任务。

showcases.title_en: Anima local agent OS for home hardware
showcases.title_zh: Anima 本地家庭硬件 Agent OS
showcases.summary_en: Explains the local decision center, cross-device coordination, long-term preference learning, Mi Home discovery, and privacy-first design behind Anima.
showcases.summary_zh: 介绍 Anima 的本地决策中枢、跨设备联动、长期偏好学习、米家设备发现和隐私优先设计。

showcases.title_zh: 组装个人 AI 电脑
showcases.summary_en: The project team explains why it wants locally owned AI compute and links open 2-, 4-, and 8-GPU build guides containing BOMs, CAD, assembly instructions, and software setup.
showcases.summary_zh: 项目团队解释为何需要自己掌控本地 AI 算力，并提供含 BOM、CAD、装配说明和软件设置的 2、4、8 GPU 构建指南。

showcases.title_zh: OpenArm 物理 AI 平台
showcases.summary_en: Walks through OpenArm's compliant, backdrivable hardware, force-feedback teleoperation, open CAD and firmware, and MuJoCo and Isaac simulation support.
showcases.summary_zh: 介绍 OpenArm 的顺应性可反驱硬件、力反馈遥操作、开放 CAD 与固件，以及 MuJoCo 和 Isaac 仿真支持。

showcases.title_zh: reBot-DevArm 开放具身 AI 栈
showcases.summary_en: Highlights the open structure files, detailed BOM, Python and ROS ecosystem, Isaac Sim, LeRobot, and visual-grasping integrations behind reBot-DevArm.
showcases.summary_zh: 突出 reBot-DevArm 的开放结构文件、详细 BOM、Python 与 ROS 生态、Isaac Sim、LeRobot 和视觉抓取集成。

showcases.title_zh: Blueprint 对话式硬件设计
showcases.summary_en: Shows a conversational design tool producing a hardware concept with a BOM, cost estimate, wiring, CAD view, tools, assembly steps, and purchase links from a natural-language request.
showcases.summary_zh: 展示对话式设计工具如何根据自然语言需求生成硬件概念、BOM、成本估算、布线、CAD 视图、工具清单、装配步骤和采购链接。

showcases.title_zh: OpenGlasses 3D 打印 AI 眼镜
showcases.summary_en: Shows a 3D-printable Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W voice-assistant eyewear concept with microphone, speaker, cloud LLM, and ElevenLabs integration; formal listing waits for a repository license.
showcases.summary_zh: 展示采用 Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W、麦克风、扬声器、云端 LLM 和 ElevenLabs 的 3D 打印语音助手眼镜；正式收录等待仓库补充许可证。

showcases.title_zh: Mentra 开放智能眼镜发布
showcases.summary_en: The team presents developer-focused smart glasses with an SDK and app store as an open alternative to closed consumer eyewear; no complete hardware source repository is linked.
showcases.summary_zh: 团队展示带 SDK 和应用商店的开发者智能眼镜，定位为封闭消费级眼镜的开放替代方案；帖子没有链接完整硬件源码仓库。

showcases.title_zh: 用 mcp2mqtt 自然语言控制硬件
showcases.summary_en: Explains how MCP clients convert natural-language requests into MQTT control and monitoring commands for lights, fans, motors, and multiple devices.
showcases.summary_zh: 介绍 MCP 客户端如何把自然语言请求转换为 MQTT 控制与监测命令，用于灯光、风扇、电机和多设备管理。

showcases.title_zh: OmiGlass 脑机接口原型
showcases.summary_en: Demonstrates an OmiGlass prototype combined with an fNIRS brain-interface sensor for all-day recording and focus or intent tracking within the broader Omi project.
showcases.summary_zh: 演示 OmiGlass 与 fNIRS 脑机传感器组合，用于全天记录以及专注度或意图追踪，归入更完整的 Omi 开源项目。
